set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin --prune; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git reset --hard origin/work/plug-screen-automation-entry-20260917; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0463af650bd647ebe300b7ec161323fda58e7520"; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$(command -v adb || true)"; if [ -z "$ADB" ] && [ -x "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" ]; then ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; fi; test -n "$ADB"; test "$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{n++} END{print n+0}')" -eq 1; $ADB shell monkey -p link.localclimate.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; PID="$($ADB shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$PID"; SOCKET="$($ADB shell cat /proc/net/unix | tr -d '\r' | awk '/webview_devtools_remote/{print $8}' | sed 's/^@//' | tail -1)"; test -n "$SOCKET"; echo "APP_PID=$PID"; echo "SOCKET=$SOCKET"; $ADB forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $ADB forward tcp:9222 localabstract:$SOCKET >/dev/null; trap '$ADB forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/list > /tmp/lcl-webview-targets.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
pages=json.load(open('/tmp/lcl-webview-targets.json'))
print('TARGET_COUNT='+str(len(pages)))
assert pages
for i,p in enumerate(pages):
 print(f'TARGET_{i}_TYPE={p.get("type","")}')
 print(f'TARGET_{i}_TITLE={p.get("title","")}')
 print(f'TARGET_{i}_URL={p.get("url","")}')
 print(f'TARGET_{i}_HAS_WS={1 if p.get("webSocketDebuggerUrl") else 0}')
assert any(p.get('type')=='page' and p.get('title')=='Local Climate Link' and p.get('url')=='https://localhost/' for p in pages)
PY
echo '=== CURRENT FOCUS ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys window | grep -m2 -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' || true; echo '=== ERROR CHECK ==='; if $ADB logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; then exit 31; else echo 'NO_FATAL_OR_ANR'; fi; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git rev-parse HEAD
